title: Fix hover-remove swatch alignment + drop default theme background from Photos list
description:
Follow-up nits from the just-shipped hover-to-remove feature (task add-hover-to-remove-control-for-selected-preset-c684). See attached screenshots.

1. **Hover/selected swatch alignment is off.** When a swatch (color or photo) is selected/hovered with the "✕" remove overlay, it renders visibly larger than its grid cell and overlaps neighboring rows/columns (see screenshots — the selected swatch balloons up and covers part of the swatch above/below it). It should stay within its normal grid cell bounds like the other swatches — just show the ✕ overlay on top, no size/scale change (or if there is a slight scale-up for affordance, keep it small enough that it doesn't overlap adjacent grid cells).

2. **Default theme (topo) background shouldn't be a removable list entry.** Currently the topo default appears as its own swatch in the Photos grid with the same hover-to-remove ✕ treatment, but it can't actually be removed since it's the fallback/default — there's nothing to fall back to if you "remove" the fallback itself. It should not be shown as a selectable/removable item in the Photos grid; it should only apply implicitly as the fallback when no other background is selected (i.e. what you get after removing whatever IS selected).

3. **HIGH PRIORITY — Right-side padding is missing on the whole Background panel grid.** The last column of both the "Colors & Gradients" grid and the "Photos" grid now runs flush to (or past) the settings panel's right edge — there is no right-side gutter, while top/left/bottom padding is intact (see latest screenshot: rightmost swatches touch the panel border, no margin like the other three sides have). This is a layout regression affecting the whole panel, not just the hover state — check the grid container/column CSS (likely a width/gap calc change introduced alongside the hover-remove work) and restore symmetric padding on all sides.

4. **Rename the new color swatch from "Garnet" to "White".** The new solid color/gradient swatch added to fill the slot freed up by removing the "no background" swatch was named/labeled "Garnet" — rename it to "White" (a plain white solid) to pair with the existing "Black" solid swatch. Update the swatch's actual color value to white, not just its label/name, if "Garnet" was a non-white color.

Relevant file: components/SettingsPanel.js (Background settings — Colors & Gradients / Photos grid rendering, grid container CSS, and hover-remove overlay), mirrored in meridian-extension/components/SettingsPanel.js.
label: Bug

activity.content:
Implemented the Background panel follow-up fixes in the source and packaged-extension mirrors.

- Removed scale-up behavior from selected presets while preserving the hover remove overlay.
- Constrained the four-column grids with `minmax(0, 1fr)` and zero-minimum preset wrappers so content cannot consume the right gutter.
- Removed the Topographic fallback from the Photos grid and restored the grid to 11 stock photos plus the custom tile.
- Replaced Garnet with a true white `#ffffff` preset labeled White.
- Updated regression coverage for all four changes.

Validation: `node --test tests/*.test.mjs` passed 137/137; mirror parity checks and `git diff --check` passed.
